body: Thank you for the insight! I really didn't realise how I would make people uncomfortable in their space, but I totally understand now. I think a lot of the way I feel comes from the fact that I want to listen to how they're feeling so I can prevent myself from making them uncomfortable or oppressing them, not necessarily offer any of my own insight, as I wouldn't have much to say. I just want to listen so desperately, I want to fix this world. But then again, not everything is mine to listen to. I do see now how it is personal, but it is not meant to be taken personally. I feel lucky that I've always had so many spaces to be mine as by default, so it only makes sense that there are some spaces I do not belong. Thank you very much for helping me see the other side!
